learnings: File type detection must correctly identify patch files (.patch, .diff) as text files, not binary - these are critical attack vectors
SVG files should not be automatically skipped as binary; they can contain executable JavaScript and should be scanned for <script> tags or event handlers
API errors should trigger retry logic or fallback to a different model rather than marking files as inconclusive
The audit tool should have a whitelist of file extensions that are always treated as text (patch, diff, svg, xml, json, etc.) regardless of content sniffing
